Arṇava
a work on Pkt. gr. ref. to in the Intro. verses of the Prākṛtamaṇidīpa of Appayya Dīkṣita III.

Arṇava
jy. q. in Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa's own C. on his Muhūrtamārtāṇḍa,

Arṇavavarṇana
a description of the sea (?) by Śrī Harṣa, mentioned by him a. the end of Canto 9 of his Naiṣadhīyacarita.
For a suggestion that it is a description of King Arṇorāja (1139 A. D.) of the Cāhamānas of Sāmbar, see Ind.
